SASBDB entry SASDGA5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDGA5/)

Publication: Jensen, Jernberg, Sinha & Colbert (2020), J Biol Chem 295, 4584
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.RA119.010697

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDGA5.dat   the curve (columns q, I, error)
  SASDGA5_fit2.fit              the CRYSOL fit of "fit2"
  SASDGA5_fit2_model1.pdb: PupR CCSSD crystal structure (with hydrogens, 15 MSE)
Only fit2 is used. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDGA5/ (buffer, temperature and wavelength: see its header comments).
Added 2026-11-15; not yet run.
